environment.description: EKS pod running the same stream processor. Kafka topic 'user-events' uses per-principal ACLs with mTLS client certificates issued by internal CA (only the upstream validation service holds a valid cert). The upstream validation service enforces Confluent Schema Registry with FULL_TRANSITIVE compatibility and a schema requiring 'body' to be a non-null record when action='process'. The downstream Lambda function URL has FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM; the function's resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to the EKS pod's IRSA role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/stream-processor-role) with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization. Unauthenticated callers receive HTTP 403. Additionally, the pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and the Kafka consumer group has a custom deserializer wrapper that returns a sentinel error on null 'body' fields for action='process', preventing the message from reaching ProcessMessage.

config.schema_registry: Confluent Schema Registry, FULL_TRANSITIVE, body required when action=process
config.lambda_resource_policy: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl granted only to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/stream-processor-role with aws:PrincipalOrgID condition
config.custom_deserializer: rejects messages where action=process and body is null/missing
